page.overview:
What is Goblet of Fire?

The Goblet of Fire was the "impartial judge" for the Triwizard Tournament which chose which students would represent their respective schools during the upcoming tasks of the Tournament.

To put forward their candidacy, students merely had to write their name on a piece of parchment and put it into the goblet's flame. When the time came for the champions to be selected, the goblet would then choose one student from each school by spitting out their name in a rush of red flames. Once chosen, the participants were subject to a binding magical contract in which they could not back out of the Tournament.

The goblet was described as being made of wood and — when active — had blue-white flames up to the edges, which turned red when someone put their name in or when it spit out the name of a chosen champion. When it was not in use, it was kept in a jewelled casket.

It acted as an impartial judge. During the 1994 Tournament, an age restriction was added and, as such, an Age Line was cast to ensure that no one under the minimum age could try to put their name into the goblet. Anyone who tried to do so with an Ageing Potion would end up being hit with its flames and forced to age even further to appear like old men, as demonstrated by what happened to Fred and George Weasley when they tried to trick the goblet via that exact method.
